description: This file defines the One2MBeanRelationship class, which manages one-to-many relationships in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for adding, removing, loading, and querying relationship data, specifically handling table-based relationships between beans.

classes.name: One2MBeanRelationship
classes.description: Represents a one-to-many table-based relationship in SuiteCRM, providing methods for managing links between beans, including adding, removing, loading, and generating SQL queries for relationship data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two beans, handling relationship existence check, relationship links update, and optional workflow and save operations.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the relationship between two beans, including related workflow triggers and saving if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads related beans in the relationship, constructing appropriate queries based on link side.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL query for fetching related bean IDs, supporting options like ordering, limiting, and filtering.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates SQL JOIN statements for including related beans in queries, supporting aliasing and join type customization.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Constructs subpanel-specific SQL queries for related data, considering various activity modules and role filters.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship already exists between two beans based on key values.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship table used for the relationship, defaulting to the RHS table if not specified.
